notes.title: Patch №3
notes.notes:
Build ver 1.06

1. Fixed bug with Niktomorph stalking you forever near the hiding locker.
2. Fixed bug with Niktomorph blocking player near wall and not killing.
3. Fixed startroom marker bug while spectating.
4. Fixed bug with player going through the locked doors by crouching.

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
🌟 Niktophobia is Coming! 🌟

We’re thrilled to announce that Niktophobia, our space horror game, is officially launching on March 20th!

Prepare yourself for a bone-chilling experience where fear comes alive in the dark. Explore the terrifying space stations, grab alien eggs . Can you survive the fear, or will it consume you?
